name: code-review
description: Review code and git history before it ships, for Spring Boot services and front-end apps (React/Next.js, Vue/Nuxt, Angular, Svelte). review-pr: a pull request or branch range - what each commit does, impact, config and database migrations against each environment, Kafka, front-end routes, API calls, env variables and security rules, plus a deep line-by-line review by the code-reviewer agent (Opus); reads Bitbucket Server/DC when configured. compare: before merging one branch into another, the missing commits and what the merge really changes. changes: what changed between two revisions of one or more services, business flows for BA/Test then config, API, database, Kafka, written into an Obsidian vault. Read-only on the repositories; Markdown reports from fixed templates.
